BETA Close X Serco Group plc has announced the purchase of 1,300,000 ordinary shares as part of its share buyback program, with purchases occurring between May 18th and May 22nd, 2026. The average price paid per share across these transactions was approximately 275.85 pence, with the lowest price at 266.80 pence and the highest at 279.40 pence. Following these purchases, Serco's total issued ordinary shares, excluding treasury shares, stand at 989,468,575. Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 22 May 2026 22 May 2026 Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Serco Group plc Transactions in own shares Serco Group plc (the " Company ") announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the " Programme ") announced on 5 March 2026, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 2 pence each (" Ordinary Shares ") through RBC Europe Limited. Date of purchase: Number of Ordinary Shares purchased: Average price paid per Share (pence): Lowest price paid per Share (pence): Highest price paid per Share (pence): 18 May 2026 261,035 270.9477 266.8000 273.2000 19 May 2026 261,824 275.8514 274.0000 277.8000 20 May 2026 280,000 275.9389 273.8000 278.8000 21 May 2026 265,295 277.6524 276.6000 279.4000 22 May 2026 270,000 277.8634 276.4000 279.0000 Following the above transactions, the Company will have 989,468,575 Ordinary Shares in issue (excluding treasury shares). The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 13,277,439 . The total number of voting rights in the Company, excluding treasury shares as at 22 May 2026 is 989,468,575 . This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. Since the announcement of the Programme on 5 March 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 13,277,439 Ordinary Shares, which are held in treasury.
